rationale: The internal option defaults to false, while native CUDA DF amplitude owners automatically enable incoming-residual weighted Anderson mixing for energies and the forward solve of complete analytic-force calls. History pairs outgoing damped Jacobi maps with incoming physical residuals using fixed validated shifted denominators. This changes the nonlinear trajectory and avoids separate trial equation evaluations; every observed state and independent expanded physical replay remain fresh. CPU, conventional, supplied-problem, Lambda/response equations and no-DIIS contracts remain unchanged. Independent complete-force gates and fresh scoped force ABBA endpoints extend the original energy qualification, without a universal convergence, statistical/global speedup or process-RSS claim.
revisit_condition: Broaden the automatic consumer domain only after independent molecular and response gates plus complete endpoint evidence; revisit the fixed weighted-error rationale if preconditioning or damping changes within a solve, or if a qualified case shows unacceptable convergence behavior.
